newsitem.title: SYRIA: Canada returns 32 smuggled mosaics to Syria.
newsitem.headline: Canada returns 32 smuggled mosaics to Syria.

text.p: Canada has handed back to Syria 32 mosaics from the 5th and 6th centuries AD which Canadian customs officers had confiscated from smugglers, the official newspaper al-Thawra said on Tuesday.
It said the mosaics, which unidentified smugglers had tried to take to Canada at the beginning of the year, arrived at the Syrian port of Latakia on Sunday.
The Syrian Antiquities Department said the mosaics had been taken from a place southeast of Aleppo, some 360 km (225 miles) north of Damascus, which historians call "the area of dead cities."
The Department said about 200 antiques were returned to Syria last year, including parts of columns, statues and other decorative and architectural pieces.
